summary: Comprehensive testing of Theme Management System and SteamGridDB Asset Engine for Vortex-Prime-emu. All 16 backend API tests pass. All frontend UI tests pass including theme CRUD, swap mechanism, and SteamGridDB asset browsing.
passed_tests: GET /api/themes - returns active and disabled theme lists (200)
GET /api/themes/active - returns currently active theme (200)
POST /api/themes/create - creates new theme in Disabled folder (200)
POST /api/themes/activate - swaps themes (old active -> Disabled, target -> Play)
POST /api/themes/deactivate - moves active theme to Disabled (200)
DELETE /api/themes/{filename} - deletes a theme (200)
GET /api/steamgriddb/search/{term} - searches SteamGridDB for games (200)
GET /api/steamgriddb/assets/{game_id} - fetches all asset types (grids, heroes, logos) (200)
GET /api/steamgriddb/grids/{game_id} - fetches grid art (200)
GET /api/steamgriddb/heroes/{game_id} - fetches hero art (200)
GET /api/steamgriddb/logos/{game_id} - fetches logo art (200)
Theme swap mechanism enforces only 1 active at a time
Multiple consecutive activations keep single active theme
Theme Manager UI - displays 5 theme cards in grid layout
Theme Manager UI - active theme has green border and ACTIVE badge
Theme Manager UI - Activate button works on disabled themes
Theme Manager UI - Deactivate button works on active theme
Asset Studio UI - search field searches SteamGridDB (found 10 results for Halo)
Asset Studio UI - selecting game shows Heroes (5), Grids (5), Logos (5)
Asset Studio UI - assets can be selected with checkmarks (hero, grid, logo all selectable)
Create Theme UI - form populated with selected SteamGridDB assets
Active theme accent color changes dashboard globally (#90c31d -> #e53935)
seed_data_creation: 5 default themes seeded on first startup (Classic Xbox 360, Midnight Blue, Crimson Red, Halo Green, Gears Gray). One is always active in Play folder.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Theme Management and SteamGridDB features fully functional. All APIs tested with pytest. Theme files stored as JSON in /app/assets/Themes/Play/ (active) and /app/assets/Themes/Disabled/. Swap mechanism properly deactivates current theme before activating new one. SteamGridDB API key is valid and working. Halo 3 game_id=37017 can be used for testing asset fetching.
